description: List items stored in your corporation hangar (item code, name, quantity). Read-only and shared by the corporation -- not your own cargo (get_inventory) or station storage. Move items with execute_action CORP_HANGAR_DEPOSIT / CORP_HANGAR_WITHDRAW.

bearer.description: Your SPACE-CORE Bearer token. Only needed if your client cannot send the Authorization header.

name: get_corp_hangar
